title: Instrumental Variables Regression for Criminological Research
Polluting Public Funds: The Effect of Environmental Regulations on Municipal Bonds
abstract:
We present two findings on how environmental policy uncertainty impacts municipal bond returns. First, yields increase after a new pollution standard is proposed but decrease after this standard is finalized. Second, after annual announcements of compliance status, yields fall for counties that remain in compliance but increase for newly noncompliant counties. We present suggestive evidence linking these short-run municipal bond market reactions to long-run changes in pollution and housing prices. Our findings suggest that increases in either regulatory stringency or uncertainty over future environmental policy increase the cost of municipal debt raised to fund schools, hospitals, and critical infrastructure.
This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance.
Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02340 .
abstract_zh:
我们就环境政策不确定性如何影响市政债券收益，提出两项发现。第一，新污染标准被提出后，收益率上升，但该标准最终确定后，收益率下降。第二，在每年公布合规状况后，持续合规的县收益率下降，而新近不合规的县收益率上升。我们提供了暗示性证据，将这些短期市政债券市场反应与长期污染和房价的变化联系起来。我们的发现表明，无论是监管严格程度的提高，还是对未来环境政策不确定性的增加，都会提高为学校、医院和关键基础设施融资而发行的市政债务成本。
本文由金融学专家Tomasz Piskorski接收。
补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可见 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02340 。

title: The Social Life Cycle Impacts of Power Plant Siting in the Historical United States
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper examines the relative contributions of siting decisions and post-siting demo-graphic shifts to current disparities in exposure to polluting fossil-fuel plants in the United States. Our analysis leverages newly digitized data on power plant siting and operations from 1900-2020, combined with spatially resolved demographics and population data from the U.S Census from 1870-2020.We find little evidence that fossil-fuel plants were disproportionately sited in counties with higher Black population shares on average. However, event study estimates indicate that Black population share grows in the decades after the first fossil-fuel plant is built in a county, with average increases in Black population share of 4 percentage points in the 50-70 years after first siting. These long-run demographic shifts are driven by counties that first hosted a fossil-fuel plant between 1900-1949.We close by exploring how these long-run demographic shifts were shaped by the Great Migration, differential sorting in response to pollution, and other factors. Our findings highlight that the equity implications of siting long-lived infrastructure can differ dramatically depending on the time span considered.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了选址决策与选址后的人口结构变化，各自对当前美国民众接触化石燃料污染电厂之程度的差异所作的相对贡献。我们的分析利用了新数字化的1900至2020年电厂选址与运营数据，并结合了1870至2020年美国人口普查中具有空间分辨率的人口统计与人口数据。我们发现，平均而言，几乎没有证据表明化石燃料电厂被不成比例地建在黑人人口比例较高的县。然而，事件研究估计结果表明，在一个县首座化石燃料电厂建成后的数十年间，黑人人口比例会上升，在选址后50至70年间，平均增加4个百分点。这些长期的人口结构变化主要由1900至1949年间首次建有化石燃料电厂的县所驱动。最后，我们探讨了这些长期人口变化如何受到大迁徙（Great Migration）、对污染的差异化分选以及其他因素的影响。我们的研究结果表明，长寿命基础设施选址的公平性影响，可能会因所考虑的时间跨度不同而产生巨大差异。

title: Blackouts: The Role of India's Wholesale Electricity Market
abstract: Blackouts impose substantial costs on electricity consumers in developing countries. We advance a new explanation for their continued prevalence in India, the world’s third-largest power sector: unlike in the developed world, utilities’ wholesale electricity demand is downward-sloping. We construct a novel dataset on power plant operations and demand. Instrumenting for cost with plausibly exogenous power plant equipment outages, we estimate a wholesale demand elasticity of –0.43. As a result, any increase in procurement costs will reduce the amount of electricity retail customers receive. Wholesale market simulations suggest that lowering procurement costs could eliminate blackouts for millions of Indian households.
abstract_zh: 停电给发展中国家的电力消费者带来了巨大成本。我们提出了一种新的解释，用以说明停电现象在印度（全球第三大电力系统）为何持续存在：与发达国家不同，电力公司的批发电力需求曲线向下倾斜。我们构建了一个关于发电厂运行与需求的新数据集。以看似外生的发电厂设备停运作为成本的工具变量，我们估计出批发需求弹性为–0.43。因此，采购成本的任何上升都将减少零售用户实际获得的电量。批发市场模拟表明，降低采购成本可能使数百万印度家庭摆脱停电困扰。

title: Dynamic Regulatory Distortions: Coal Procurement at U.S. Power Plants
Impacts of the Clean Air Act on the Power Sector from 1938-1994: Anticipation and Adaptation
The Health Costs of Coal-Fired Power Plants in India
abstract: This paper estimates the effect of coal-fired power plants on infant mortality in India. We find that a one GW increase in coal-fired capacity corresponds to a 14% increase in infant mortality rates in districts near versus far from the plant site. This effect is 2-3 times larger than estimates from the developed world. Our effects are larger for: (1) older plants, (2) plants located in areas with higher baseline levels of pollution, and (3) plants burning domestic rather than imported coal. The environmental benefits from policy aimed at the power sector are thus likely to be substantially higher if targeted at older plants located in more polluted areas tailored to burn domestic rather than imported coal.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了燃煤电厂对印度婴儿死亡率的影响。我们发现，燃煤装机容量每增加1吉瓦，电厂附近地区与远离电厂的地区相比，婴儿死亡率上升14%。这一效应是发达国家估计值的2至3倍。以下情形下的效应更大：（1）较老的电厂；（2）位于基线污染水平较高地区的电厂；（3）燃烧国产煤而非进口煤的电厂。因此，若电力行业的政策针对较老的、位于污染较严重地区、并且燃烧国产煤而非进口煤的电厂，其环境收益很可能会显著更高。

title: Carbon Rollercoaster: A Historical Analysis of Decarbonization in the United States
abstract: This paper documents the evolution of US carbon emissions and discusses the main factors that contributed to the historical carbon emissions rollercoaster. We divide the discussion into four periodsup to 1920, 1920-1960, 1960-2005 and after 2005.For each period, we discuss the main drivers of national carbon emissions. We then discuss trends in carbon emissions in the electricity sector. Electricity sector emissions were initially very small, but would become the largest source of US carbon emissions over the period 1980-2015, and the largest contributor to decarbonization since 2007.In the final section, we distill lessons from the U.S. experience that may inform decarbonization strategies in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 本文梳理了美国碳排放的演变历程，并讨论了导致历史上碳排放“过山车式”波动的主要因素。我们将讨论分为四个时期：1920年以前、1920至1960年、1960至2005年以及2005年以后。对于每个时期，我们讨论全国碳排放的主要驱动因素。随后，我们讨论电力部门碳排放的趋势。电力部门的排放起初非常少，但在1980至2015年间成为美国最大的碳排放来源，并且自2007年以来是脱碳的最大贡献者。在最后一节，我们总结了美国经验中的若干教训，这些教训可能为发展中经济体的脱碳战略提供参考。

title: Start-up Costs and Market Power: Lessons from the Renewable Energy Transition
abstract: Firms expect to recover the fixed costs required to start production by earning positive operating profits in subsequent periods. We develop a dynamic competitive benchmark that accounts for start-up costs, showing that static markups overstate the rents attributable to market power in an electricity market where generators frequently stop and start production in response to rooftop solar output. We demonstrate that the large-scale expansion of solar capacity can lead to increases in the collective profitability of fossil fuel plants because competition softens at sunset—plants displaced by solar during the day must incur start-up costs to compete in the evening. (JEL D24, L13, L25, L94, Q41, Q42)
abstract_zh: 企业预期通过在随后各期获得正的经营利润，来收回启动生产所需的固定成本。我们建立了一个考虑启动成本的动态竞争基准，表明在一个发电企业因屋顶太阳能产出而频繁停产和重启生产的电力市场中，静态加成会高估归因于市场势力的租金。我们证明，太阳能装机规模的大规模扩张可能导致化石燃料电厂的集体盈利能力上升，因为竞争在日落时分有所减弱：白天被太阳能挤出的电厂必须承担启动成本，才能在傍晚重新参与竞争。（JEL D24, L13, L25, L94, Q41, Q42）

title: The Impact of Air Pollution on Petcare Utilization
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Air pollution is one of the leading causes of morbidity and premature mortality globally. A large literature documents the adverse impacts of ambient air pollution on human health. In contrast, there is a lack of comparable research studying the effects of air pollution on animal health. We fill this gap, utilizing 5 y of data on over seven million visits to veterinary practices across the United Kingdom. Leveraging within-city variation in daily monitor-measured air pollution levels, we find that increases in fine particulate matter (i.e., PM
2.5
) are associated with significant increases in the number of vet visits for both cats and dogs. In aggregate, these estimates suggest that reducing ambient PM
2.5
levels to a maximum of 5 μg per cubic meter as recommended by the World Health Organization would result in a 0.7 to 2.5% reduction in vet visits.
abstract_zh: 空气污染是全球发病和过早死亡的主要原因之一。大量文献记录了环境空气污染对人类健康的不利影响。相比之下，关于空气污染对动物健康影响的可比研究却很缺乏。我们填补了这一空白，利用英国各地兽医诊所5年间超过700万次就诊的数据。借助城市内部每日监测站测得的空气污染水平差异，我们发现细颗粒物（PM2.5）的增加与猫和狗的兽医就诊次数显著增加相关。总体而言，这些估计表明，将环境PM2.5水平降至世界卫生组织建议的每立方米不超过5微克，将使兽医就诊次数减少0.7%至2.5%。

title: Evaluation of the Winter Pollution Mitigation Policy in China
Can Forward Commodity Markets Improve Spot Market Performance? Evidence from Wholesale Electricity
abstract: Forward markets are believed to aggregate information about future spot prices and reduce the cost of producing the commodity. We develop a measure of the extent to which forward and spot prices agree in markets with transaction costs. Using this measure, we show that day-ahead prices better reflect real-time prices at all locations in California’s electricity market after the introduction of financial trading. We then present evidence suggesting that operating costs and input fuel use fell after the introduction of financial trading on days when the nonconvexities inherent to the production and transmission of electricity are especially relevant. (JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48)
abstract_zh: 远期市场被认为能够汇总关于未来现货价格的信息，并降低商品的生产成本。我们构建了一个指标，用以衡量在存在交易成本的市场中远期价格与现货价格的吻合程度。利用该指标，我们表明，在引入金融交易之后，加州电力市场各地点的日前价格都更好地反映了实时价格。随后，我们提供证据表明，在电力生产和输送所固有的非凸性尤为突出的日子里，引入金融交易之后运营成本和投入燃料使用量均有所下降。（JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48）

title: Regulatory Induced Risk Aversion in Coal Contracting at U.S. Power Plants: Implications for Environmental Policy
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Seminal work argues that electric utilities sign long-term contracts with coal suppliers prior to making relationship-specific investments in order to avoid the possibility of ex post hold-up. This paper provides empirical evidence that risk aversion also plays an important role in the coal contracting behavior of US power plants. Specifically, I show that plants facing more spot coal price uncertainty sign longer duration coal contracts, purchase contract coal from a larger number of origin counties, and pay higher contract coal prices. One plausible mechanism for this risk aversion is that regulators are less likely to incorporate high input cost realizations into the regulated output price they set for electric utilities. Using my estimate of plant-level risk aversion, I calculate that the ratio of the aggregate costs incurred by plants under cap and trade relative to a carbon tax is 1.27. This highlights the importance of implementing climate policy that limits carbon price volatility.
abstract_zh: 经典研究认为，电力公司会在进行专用性投资之前与煤炭供应商签订长期合同，以避免事后被套牢（hold-up）的可能性。本文提供了实证证据，表明风险厌恶在美国电厂的煤炭合同行为中也发挥着重要作用。具体而言，我发现，面临更大现货煤炭价格不确定性的电厂会签订期限更长的煤炭合同，从更多产地县采购合同煤，并支付更高的合同煤价格。这种风险厌恶的一种合理机制是：监管者不太可能将高昂的投入成本实现值纳入其为电力公司设定的受监管产出价格中。利用我对电厂层面风险厌恶程度的估计，我计算出，在总量控制与交易制度下，各电厂承担的总成本与在碳税下的比值为1.27。这突出了实施限制碳价格波动的气候政策的重要性。

title: U.S. Embassy Air Quality Tweets Led to Global Health Benefits
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
The World Health Organization estimates that over 90% of the world’s population is exposed to hazardous levels of local air pollution. Air pollution is markedly worse in low- and middle-income countries, yet air-quality monitoring is typically sparse. In 2008, the US Embassy in Beijing began tweeting hourly air-quality information from a newly installed pollution monitor, dramatically improving the information on air quality available to Beijing residents. Since then, the United States has installed over 50 monitors around the world, tweeting real-time reports on air quality in those locations. Using spatially granular measurements of local air pollution from satellite data that span the globe, we employ variation in whether and when US embassies installed monitors to evaluate the impact of air-quality information on pollution. We estimate that embassy monitors led to reductions in fine particulate concentration levels in host countries of 2 to 4 µg/m
3
. Our central estimate of the annual monetized benefit of the decrease in premature mortality due to this reduction in pollution is $127 million for the median city in 2019. Our findings point to the substantial benefits of improving the availability and salience of air-quality information in low- and middle-income countries.
abstract_zh: 世界卫生组织估计，全球90%以上的人口暴露于有害水平的本地空气污染之中。低收入和中等收入国家的空气污染明显更严重，但空气质量监测通常十分稀少。2008年，美国驻北京大使馆开始每小时通过推特（Twitter）发布新安装的污染监测仪所测得的空气质量信息，极大地改善了北京居民可获得的空气质量信息。此后，美国在全球各地安装了50多台监测仪，并通过推特实时发布这些地点的空气质量报告。我们利用覆盖全球的卫星数据所提供的空间精细的本地空气污染测量，利用美国大使馆是否安装监测仪以及何时安装的差异，评估空气质量信息对污染的影响。我们估计，大使馆监测仪使东道国的细颗粒物浓度降低了2至4微克/立方米。我们的中心估计显示，就2019年的中位城市而言，这一污染减少所带来的过早死亡减少的年度货币化收益为1.27亿美元。我们的发现表明，在低收入和中等收入国家，提高空气质量信息的可获得性和显著性，具有可观的收益。

title: Considering the Nuclear Option: Hidden Benefits and Social Costs of Nuclear Power in the U.S. Since 1970
Does Environmental Policy Affect Income Inequality? Evidence from the Clean Air Act
abstract: This paper quantifies the impact of environmental policy on income inequality. We focus on the Clean Air act and the National Ambient Air Quality standards for fine particulate matter and ozone. Using a matched difference-in-differences estimator, we find evidence that both standards increased inequality in market income and a measure of income that deducts per-capita air pollution damage from adjusted gross income. While pollution standards can reduce pollution levels and thus result in significant environmental benefits in aggregate, our findings suggest that these standards appear to distort the distribution of economic resources in complex, and at times unfortunate, ways.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了环境政策对收入不平等的影响。我们聚焦于《清洁空气法》以及针对细颗粒物和臭氧的国家环境空气质量标准。采用匹配双重差分估计量，我们发现有证据表明，这两项标准都加剧了市场收入的不平等，也加剧了一项收入指标的不平等，该指标是从调整后的总收入中扣除人均空气污染损害后得到的。尽管污染标准能够降低污染水平，从而在总体上带来显著的环境效益，但我们的研究结果表明，这些标准似乎以复杂、有时甚至不幸的方式扭曲了经济资源的分配。

title: The Superintendent's Dilemma: Managing School District Capacity as Parents Vote with Their Feet
Does Environmental Policy Affect Scaling Laws between Population and Pollution? Evidence from American Metropolitan Areas
abstract: Modern cities are engines of production, innovation, and growth. However, urbanization also increases both local and global pollution from household consumption and firms' production. Do emissions change proportionately to city size or does pollution tend to outpace or lag urbanization? Do emissions scale differently with population versus economic growth or are emissions, population, and economic growth inextricably linked? How are the scaling relationships between emissions, population, and economic growth affected by environmental regulation? This paper examines the link between urbanization, economic growth and pollution using data from Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSAs) in the United States between 1999 and 2011. We find that the emissions of local air pollution in these MSAs scale according to a ¾ power law with both population size and gross domestic product (GDP). However, the monetary damages from these local emissions scale linearly with both population and GDP. Counties that have previously been out of attainment with the local air quality standards set by the Clean Air Act show an entirely different relationship: local emissions scale according to the square root of population, while the monetary damages from local air pollution follow a 2/3rds power law with population. Counties out of attainment are subject to more stringent emission controls; we argue based on this that enforcement of the Clean Air Act induces sublinear scaling between emissions, damages, and city size. In contrast, we find that metropolitan GDP scales super-linearly with population in all MSAs regardless of attainment status. Summarizing, our findings suggest that environmental policy limits the adverse effects of urbanization without interfering with the productivity benefits that manifest in cities.
abstract_zh: 现代城市是生产、创新和增长的引擎。然而，城市化也会增加家庭消费和企业生产所造成的本地及全球污染。排放量是否与城市规模成比例变化，还是污染的增长快于或慢于城市化？排放与人口增长和经济增长之间的标度关系是否不同，或者排放、人口与经济增长是否密不可分？环境监管如何影响排放、人口与经济增长之间的标度关系？本文利用1999年至2011年美国大都市统计区（MSA）的数据，考察了城市化、经济增长与污染之间的联系。我们发现，这些大都市统计区的本地空气污染排放与人口规模和国内生产总值（GDP）均服从3/4幂律。然而，这些本地排放所造成的货币损害则与人口和GDP均呈线性关系。此前未达到《清洁空气法》所设地方空气质量标准的县，则呈现出截然不同的关系：本地排放与人口的平方根成比例，而本地空气污染的货币损害则随人口呈2/3次幂律变化。未达标的县受到更为严格的排放控制；基于此，我们认为《清洁空气法》的执行促成了排放、损害与城市规模之间的次线性标度关系。相比之下，无论是否达标，我们发现所有大都市统计区的大都市GDP均随人口呈超线性增长。总之，我们的研究结果表明，环境政策能够限制城市化的不利影响，同时又不妨碍城市中所体现的生产率优势。
